  have hL : ∀ a ∈ A, a • A = A * A := fun a ha =>
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.smul_finset_subset_mul ha)
      (by rw [Finset.card_smul_finset]; exact hA)
  have hR : ∀ a ∈ A, op a • A = A * A := fun a ha =>
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.op_smul_finset_subset_mul ha)
      (by rw [Finset.card_smul_finset]; exact hA)
  have key : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ h : G, h • A = A → a * h ∈ A := by
    intro a ha h hh
    have h1 : h * a ∈ A := by rw [← hh]; exact Finset.smul_mem_smul_finset ha
    have h2 : a * (h * a) ∈ A * A := by
      rw [← hL a ha]; exact Finset.smul_mem_smul_finset h1
    rw [← hR a ha] at h2
    obtain ⟨c, hc, e⟩ := Finset.mem_smul_finset.mp h2
    have : c * a = a * (h * a) := by simpa using e
    have : c = a * h := by

    rw [← this]; exact hc
  refine ⟨MulAction.stabilizer G A, fun a ha => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩

      show (a⁻¹ * x) • A = A

lemma proposition_3_3 [DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G} (hA₀ : A.Nonempty) (hA : #(A ^ 2) ≤ K * #A) :
    ∃ S ⊆ (A⁻¹ * A) ^ 2, IsApproximateSubgroup (2 ^ 12 * K ^ 36) (S : Set G) ∧

proof:
:= by
  have hA' : (#(A * A) : ℝ) ≤ K * #A := by rwa [← pow_two]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < #A := by exact_mod_cast hA₀.card_pos
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := one_le_of_le_mul_right₀ hpos <|
    calc (#A : ℝ) ≤ #(A * A) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card_mul_left hA₀
      _ ≤ K * #A := hA'
  have hK0 : 0 < K := by linarith
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Finset G, S = {g ∈ A⁻¹ * A | #A / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• g ∩ A)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ∀ g, g ∈ S ↔ g ∈ A⁻¹ * A ∧ (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• g ∩ A) := by
    intro g; rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter]
  have hS₁ : 1 ∈ S := by
    rw [hmem]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA₀
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨a⁻¹, Finset.mem_inv'.2 (by simpa using ha), a, ha, inv_mul_cancel a⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [aux_rsmul_one, Finset.inter_self, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hSA : S ⊆ A⁻¹ * A := fun g hg => ((hmem g).1 hg).1
  have hSsymm : S⁻¹ = S := by
    have h : ∀ g ∈ S, g⁻¹ ∈ S := by
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hmem g).1 hg
      rw [hmem]
      refine ⟨?_, by rw [aux_card_inv]; exact h2⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 h1
      exact Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨y⁻¹, Finset.mem_inv'.2 (by simpa using hy), x⁻¹,
        Finset.mem_inv'.1 hx, by simp⟩
    ext g
    rw [Finset.mem_inv']
    exact ⟨fun hg => by simpa using h _ hg, fun hg => h g hg⟩
  have hSmem : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ f ∈ A, (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• a ∩ A <• f) → a * f⁻¹ ∈ S := by
    intro a ha f hf hle
    rw [hmem]
    have hne : (A <• a ∩ A <• f).Nonempty := by
      rw [← Finset.card_pos]
      have : (0 : ℝ) < #(A <• a ∩ A <• f) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hle
      exact_mod_cast this
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.1 hz
    have hz1' := aux_mem_rsmul.1 hz1
    have hz2' := aux_mem_rsmul.1 hz2
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨(z * a⁻¹)⁻¹, Finset.mem_inv'.2 (by simpa using hz1'), z * f⁻¹, hz2',
      by group⟩, ?_⟩
    have h := aux_card_inter (A <• (a * f⁻¹)) A f
    rw [aux_rsmul_rsmul, inv_mul_cancel_right] at h
    rw [← h]; exact hle
  obtain ⟨F, hFA, hFcard, hASF⟩ := aux_cover hA₀ hK hA' hS₁ hSmem
  have hFne : F.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA₀
    obtain ⟨s, _, f, hf, _⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 (hASF ha)
    exact ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hAcard : (#A : ℝ) ≤ #S * (2 * K) := by
    calc (#A : ℝ) ≤ #(S * F) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hASF
      _ ≤ #S * #F := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_mul_le
      _ ≤ #S * (2 * K) := by gcongr

  have hR : (#(A * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤ K ^ 2 * #A := aux_ruzsa hA₀ hA'
  have hSd : ∀ g ∈ S, (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• g ∩ A) := fun g hg => ((hmem g).1 hg).2
  have hR0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ #(A * A⁻¹) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have b1 : (#(A * S * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * K * (K ^ 2 * #A) * K ^ 2 := by
    apply aux_step hpos hK (aux_key hK0 hSd A A⁻¹) (p := #(A * A⁻¹)) (q := #(A * A⁻¹)) hR
      (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have b2 : (#(A * S * S * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * K * (2 * K * (K ^ 2 * #A) * K ^ 2) * K ^ 2 := by
    apply aux_step hpos hK (aux_key hK0 hSd (A * S) A⁻¹) (p := #(A * S * A⁻¹)) (q := #(A * A⁻¹))
      b1 (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have b3 : (#(A * S * S * S * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * K * (2 * K * (2 * K * (K ^ 2 * #A) * K ^ 2) * K ^ 2) * K ^ 2 := by
    apply aux_step hpos hK (aux_key hK0 hSd (A * S * S) A⁻¹) (p := #(A * S * S * A⁻¹))
      (q := #(A * A⁻¹)) b2 (by linarith) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have b4 : (#(A * S ^ 3 * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤ 8 * K ^ 11 * #A := by
    have : A * S ^ 3 * A⁻¹ = A * S * S * S * A⁻¹ := by
      simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_assoc]
    rw [this]; refine b3.trans (le_of_eq ?_); ring
  have b5 : (#(S ^ 3) : ℝ) ≤ 8 * K ^ 11 * #A := by
    refine le_trans ?_ b4
    calc (#(S ^ 3) : ℝ) ≤ #(A * S ^ 3) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card_mul_left hA₀
      _ ≤ #(A * S ^ 3 * A⁻¹) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card_mul_right hA₀.inv
  have hSS : S ⊆ S ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have := Finset.mul_mem_mul hx hS₁
    rwa [mul_one, ← pow_two] at this
  refine ⟨S ^ 2, by gcongr, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show 2 ^ 12 * K ^ 36 = (2 ^ 4 * K ^ 12) ^ 3 by ring, Finset.coe_pow]
    refine .of_small_tripling hS₁ hSsymm ?_
    calc (#(S ^ 3) : ℝ) ≤ 8 * K ^ 11 * #A := b5
      _ ≤ 8 * K ^ 11 * (#S * (2 * K)) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 ^ 4 * K ^ 12 * #S := by ring
  · have hS2 : (#(S ^ 2) : ℝ) ≤ #(S ^ 3) := by
      refine Nat.cast_le.2 (Finset.card_le_card ?_)
      intro x hx
      have := Finset.mul_mem_mul hx hS₁
      rwa [mul_one, ← pow_succ] at this
    have : (8 : ℝ) * K ^ 11 * #A ≤ 16 * K ^ 12 * #A := by
      have : K ^ 11 ≤ K ^ 12 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hK (by norm_num)
      nlinarith [pow_pos hK0 11]
    linarith
  · have hcov : ∀ a ∈ A, a ∈ F.biUnion (fun f => A ∩ (S ^ 2) <• f) := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨s, hs, f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 (hASF ha)
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨f, hf, Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨ha, aux_mem_rsmul.2 ?_⟩⟩
      simpa using hSS hs
    have hsum : (#A : ℝ) ≤ ∑ f ∈ F, (#(A ∩ (S ^ 2) <• f) : ℝ) := by
      have := Finset.card_le_card (fun a ha => hcov a ha)
      have h2 := Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := F) (t := fun f => A ∩ (S ^ 2) <• f)
      exact_mod_cast this.trans h2
    have hFpos : (0 : ℝ) < #F := by exact_mod_cast hFne.card_pos
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hle⟩ := Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le hFne
      (f := fun _ => (#A : ℝ) / #F) (g := fun f => (#(A ∩ (S ^ 2) <• f) : ℝ)) (by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        calc (#F : ℝ) * (#A / #F) = #A := by field_simp
          _ ≤ _ := hsum)
    refine ⟨f, hFA hf, le_trans ?_ hle⟩
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hpos.le hFpos hFcard

lemma aux_mem_rsmul [DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G} {g x : G} : x ∈ A <• g ↔ x * g⁻¹ ∈ A := by
  simp only [Finset.mem_smul_finset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; simpa using hy
  · intro h; exact ⟨_, h, by simp⟩

lemma aux_card_inter [DecidableEq G] (A B : Finset G) (g : G) :
    #(A <• g ∩ B <• g) = #(A ∩ B) := by
  rw [← Finset.smul_finset_inter, Finset.card_smul_finset]

lemma aux_rsmul_rsmul [DecidableEq G] (A : Finset G) (g h : G) : (A <• g) <• h = A <• (g * h) := by
  ext x; rw [aux_mem_rsmul, aux_mem_rsmul, aux_mem_rsmul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]

lemma aux_rsmul_one [DecidableEq G] (A : Finset G) : A <• (1 : G) = A := by
  ext x; rw [aux_mem_rsmul]; simp

lemma aux_card_rsmul [DecidableEq G] (A : Finset G) (g : G) : #(A <• g) = #A := by
  simp [Finset.card_smul_finset]

lemma aux_card_inv [DecidableEq G] (A : Finset G) (g : G) :
    #(A <• g⁻¹ ∩ A) = #(A <• g ∩ A) := by
  have h := aux_card_inter (A <• g⁻¹) A g
  rw [aux_rsmul_rsmul, inv_mul_cancel, aux_rsmul_one, Finset.inter_comm] at h
  exact h.symm

lemma aux_fiber {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] (T : Finset γ) (P : Finset α) (Q : Finset β)
    (φ : α → β → γ) (m : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ u ∈ T, m ≤ #{pq ∈ P ×ˢ Q | φ pq.1 pq.2 = u}) : #T * m ≤ #P * #Q := by
  classical
  set s : Finset (α × β) := {pq ∈ P ×ˢ Q | φ pq.1 pq.2 ∈ T} with hs
  have h1 : #s = ∑ u ∈ T, #{a ∈ s | φ a.1 a.2 = u} :=
    Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun pq : α × β => φ pq.1 pq.2) (by
      intro x hx; simp [hs] at hx; exact hx.2)
  have h2 : ∀ u ∈ T, m ≤ (#{a ∈ s | φ a.1 a.2 = u} : ℝ) := by
    intro u hu
    have : {a ∈ s | φ a.1 a.2 = u} = {pq ∈ P ×ˢ Q | φ pq.1 pq.2 = u} := by
      ext a
      simp only [hs, Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h3⟩; exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩; exact ⟨⟨h1, h3 ▸ hu⟩, h3⟩
    rw [this]; exact h u hu
  have h3 : (#T : ℝ) * m ≤ #s := by
    have := Finset.sum_le_sum h2
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at this
    rw [h1]; push_cast; exact this
  have h4 : #s ≤ #(P ×ˢ Q) := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  calc (#T : ℝ) * m ≤ #s := h3
    _ ≤ #(P ×ˢ Q) := by exact_mod_cast h4
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.card_product]; push_cast; ring

lemma aux_ruzsa [DecidableEq G] {A : Finset G} (hA₀ : A.Nonempty) (hA : (#(A * A) : ℝ) ≤ K * #A) :
    (#(A * A⁻¹) : ℝ) ≤ K ^ 2 * #A := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < #A := by exact_mod_cast hA₀.card_pos
  have h := aux_fiber (A * A⁻¹) (A * A) (A * A) (fun p q => p * q⁻¹) (#A : ℝ) (by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z', hz', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 hu
    have hz : z'⁻¹ ∈ A := Finset.mem_inv'.1 hz'
    have : #A ≤ #{pq ∈ (A * A) ×ˢ (A * A) | pq.1 * pq.2⁻¹ = y * z'} := by
      refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => (y * x, z'⁻¹ * x)) ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx
        have hx : x ∈ A := hx
        simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_product]
        refine ⟨⟨Finset.mul_mem_mul hy hx, Finset.mul_mem_mul hz hx⟩, ?_⟩
        group
      · intro x _ x' _ hxx
        have := congrArg Prod.fst hxx
        simpa using this
    exact_mod_cast this)
  have h2 : (#(A * A) : ℝ) * #(A * A) ≤ (K * #A) * (K * #A) :=
    mul_le_mul hA hA (by positivity) (by nlinarith [hA, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (#(A * A))])
  have h3 : (#(A * A⁻¹) : ℝ) * #A ≤ (K ^ 2 * #A) * #A := by nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hpos

lemma aux_key [DecidableEq G] {A S : Finset G} (_hK : 0 < K)
    (hS : ∀ g ∈ S, (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• g ∩ A)) (X Y : Finset G) :
    (#(X * S * Y) : ℝ) * (#A / (2 * K)) ≤ #(X * A⁻¹) * #(A * Y) := by
  refine aux_fiber (X * S * Y) (X * A⁻¹) (A * Y) (fun p q => p * q) _ ?_
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨w, hw, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 hu
  obtain ⟨x, hx, s, hs, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.1 hw
  refine (hS s hs).trans ?_
  have : #(A <• s ∩ A) ≤ #{pq ∈ (X * A⁻¹) ×ˢ (A * Y) | pq.1 * pq.2 = x * s * y} := by
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun d => (x * (d * s⁻¹)⁻¹, d * y)) ?_ ?_
    · intro d hd
      have hd : d ∈ A <• s ∩ A := hd
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.1 hd
      have h1' : d * s⁻¹ ∈ A := aux_mem_rsmul.1 h1
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_product]
      refine ⟨⟨Finset.mul_mem_mul hx (Finset.mem_inv'.2 (by simpa using h1')),
        Finset.mul_mem_mul h2 hy⟩, ?_⟩
      group
    · intro d _ d' _ hdd
      have := congrArg Prod.snd hdd
      simpa using this
  exact_mod_cast this

lemma aux_step {t a K p q c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (h : t * (a / (2 * K)) ≤ p * q) (hp : p ≤ c) (hq : q ≤ d * a) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) :
    t ≤ 2 * K * c * d := by
  have hK0 : 0 < K := by linarith
  have h1 : t * a ≤ 2 * K * (p * q) := by
    have : t * (a / (2 * K)) * (2 * K) = t * a := by field_simp
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * K)]
  have h2 : p * q ≤ c * (d * a) := mul_le_mul hp hq hq0 (le_trans hp0 hp)
  have h3 : t * a ≤ (2 * K * c * d) * a := by nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 ha

lemma aux_cover [DecidableEq G] {A S : Finset G} (hA₀ : A.Nonempty) (hK : 1 ≤ K)

    (hSmem : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ f ∈ A, (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• a ∩ A <• f) → a * f⁻¹ ∈ S) :

    intro a ha
    by_cases haF : a ∈ F
    · exact Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨1, h1, a, haF, one_mul _⟩
    · have hnP : ¬ P (insert a F) := by

        have := hmax (insert a F) (Finset.mem_filter.2
          ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.2 (Finset.insert_subset ha hFA), hP'⟩)
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem haF] at this
        omega
      simp only [hP, not_forall, not_lt, Finset.mem_insert] at hnP
      obtain ⟨f, hf, f', hf', hne, hle⟩ := hnP
      have key : ∃ f ∈ F, (#A : ℝ) / (2 * K) ≤ #(A <• a ∩ A <• f) := by
        rcases hf with rfl | hf <;> rcases hf' with rfl | hf'
        · exact absurd rfl hne
        · exact ⟨f', hf', hle⟩
        · exact ⟨f, hf, by rwa [Finset.inter_comm]⟩
        · exact absurd hle (not_le.2 (hFP f hf f' hf' hne))
      obtain ⟨f, hfF, hf⟩ := key
      exact Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨a * f⁻¹, hSmem a ha f (hFA hfF) hf, f, hfF, by simp⟩
  refine ⟨F, hFA, ?_, hcover⟩

  have hsub : ∀ f ∈ F, A <• f ⊆ U := by
    intro f hf x hx
    have := aux_mem_rsmul.1 hx
    exact Finset.mem_mul.2 ⟨x * f⁻¹, this, f, hFA hf, by simp⟩
  set N : G → ℝ := fun x => ∑ f ∈ F, if x ∈ A <• f then (1 : ℝ) else 0 with hN
  have S1 : ∑ x ∈ U, N x = #F * #A := by
    simp only [hN]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have : ∀ f ∈ F, ∑ x ∈ U, (if x ∈ A <• f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = #A := by
      intro f hf
      rw [Finset.sum_boole, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 (hsub f hf),
        aux_card_rsmul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hterm : ∀ f ∈ F, ∀ f' ∈ F, ∑ x ∈ U, ((if x ∈ A <• f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
      (if x ∈ A <• f' then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≤ (if f = f' then (#A : ℝ) else 0) + #A / (2 * K) := by
    intro f hf f' hf'
    have e : ∑ x ∈ U, ((if x ∈ A <• f then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (if x ∈ A <• f' then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≤ (#(A <• f ∩ A <• f') : ℝ) := by
      calc _ = ∑ x ∈ U, (if x ∈ A <• f ∩ A <• f' then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by

        _ = #(U.filter (· ∈ A <• f ∩ A <• f')) := by rw [Finset.sum_boole]

    by_cases hff : f = f'

      rw [Finset.inter_self, aux_card_rsmul] at e

      linarith

      simp only [hN, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun f _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [e1]

          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun f hf => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun f' hf' => hterm f hf f' hf'))
      _ = ∑ f ∈ F, ((#A : ℝ) + #F * (#A / (2 * K))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun f hf => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
          simp [hf]
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have CS := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := U) (f := N)
  rw [S1] at CS

namespace Finset
variable {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {𝒜 : Finset (Finset ι)}
  {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → E} {r : ℝ}

def loBnd (n j : ℕ) : ℕ := if j ≤ n then n.choose ((n - j) / 2) else 0

lemma loBnd_succ_zero (n : ℕ) : loBnd (n + 1) 0 = loBnd n 0 + loBnd n 1 := by
  unfold loBnd
  by_cases h : 1 ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega), if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' n
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [show (2 * (m + 1) + 1 - 0) / 2 = m + 1 by omega, show (2 * (m + 1) - 0) / 2 = m + 1 by omega,
        show (2 * (m + 1) - 1) / 2 = m by omega, Nat.choose_succ_succ']
      omega
    · rw [show (2 * m + 1 + 1 - 0) / 2 = m + 1 by omega, show (2 * m + 1 - 0) / 2 = m by omega,
        show (2 * m + 1 - 1) / 2 = m by omega, Nat.choose_succ_succ']
      have := Nat.choose_symm_half m
      omega
  · have : n = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    simp

lemma loBnd_succ_succ (n j : ℕ) : loBnd (n + 1) (j + 1) = loBnd n j + loBnd n (j + 2) := by
  unfold loBnd
  by_cases h : j + 2 ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega), if_pos h]
    have e1 : (n + 1 - (j + 1)) / 2 = (n - (j + 2)) / 2 + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : (n - j) / 2 = (n - (j + 2)) / 2 + 1 := by omega
    rw [e1, e2, Nat.choose_succ_succ']; omega
  · rw [if_neg h, add_zero]
    by_cases h3 : j ≤ n
    · rw [if_pos h3, if_pos (by omega : j + 1 ≤ n + 1)]
      have e1 : (n + 1 - (j + 1)) / 2 = 0 := by omega
      have e2 : (n - j) / 2 = 0 := by omega
      rw [e1, e2]; simp
    · rw [if_neg h3, if_neg (by omega)]

lemma exists_chain_cover [DecidableEq ι] (hr : 0 < r) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, r ≤ ‖f i‖) :
    ∃ P : Finset (Finset (Finset ι)), (∀ t ⊆ s, ∃ 𝒜 ∈ P, t ∈ 𝒜) ∧ (∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, 𝒜.Nonempty) ∧
      (∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, ∀ t ∈ 𝒜, t ⊆ s) ∧
      (∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, (𝒜 : Set (Finset ι)).Pairwise fun u v ↦ r ≤ dist (∑ i ∈ u, f i) (∑ i ∈ v, f i)) ∧
      ∀ j, #(P.filter fun 𝒜 => j < #𝒜) ≤ loBnd #s j := by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨{{∅}}, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have : t = ∅ := subset_empty.1 ht
      subst this; simp
    · simp
    · simp
    · intro 𝒜 h; simp at h; subst h; simp
    · intro j
      rcases j with _ | j
      · exact (card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp [loBnd])
      · have : (({{∅}} : Finset (Finset (Finset ι))).filter fun 𝒜 => j + 1 < #𝒜) = ∅ := by
          ext x; simp; intro hx; subst hx; simp
        rw [this]; simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
  obtain ⟨P, hcov, hne, hsub, hsep, hprof⟩ := ih fun j hj ↦ hf _ <| mem_insert_of_mem hj
  clear ih
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩ :=
    exists_dual_vector ℝ (f i) (hr.trans_le <| hf _ <| mem_insert_self _ _).ne'
  have hfi : r ≤ g (f i) := by rw [hgf]; exact hf _ (mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hgd : ∀ a b : E, g a - g b ≤ dist a b := by
    intro a b
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub]
    calc g (a - b) ≤ ‖g (a - b)‖ := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖a - b‖ := g.le_opNorm _
      _ = ‖a - b‖ := by rw [hg, one_mul]
  choose! t ht using fun 𝒜 (h𝒜 : 𝒜 ∈ P) ↦
    Finset.exists_max_image 𝒜 (fun t ↦ g (∑ i ∈ t, f i)) (hne 𝒜 h𝒜)
  have hiu : ∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, ∀ u ∈ 𝒜, i ∉ u := fun 𝒜 h u hu hiu => hi (hsub 𝒜 h u hu hiu)
  have hc1 : ∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, #(insert (insert i (t 𝒜)) 𝒜) = #𝒜 + 1 := by
    intro 𝒜 h
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem]
    intro hm
    exact hi (hsub 𝒜 h _ hm (mem_insert_self _ _))
  have hinj : ∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, Set.InjOn (insert i) (𝒜.erase (t 𝒜) : Set (Finset ι)) := by
    intro 𝒜 h u hu v hv huv
    have hu' := hiu 𝒜 h u (mem_of_mem_erase hu)
    have hv' := hiu 𝒜 h v (mem_of_mem_erase hv)
    rw [← erase_insert hu', huv, erase_insert hv']
  have hc2 : ∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, #((𝒜.erase (t 𝒜)).image (insert i)) = #𝒜 - 1 := by
    intro 𝒜 h
    rw [card_image_of_injOn (hinj 𝒜 h), card_erase_of_mem (ht 𝒜 h).1]
  refine ⟨P.image (fun 𝒜 => insert (insert i (t 𝒜)) 𝒜) ∪
    (P.filter (fun 𝒜 => 2 ≤ #𝒜)).image (fun 𝒜 => (𝒜.erase (t 𝒜)).image (insert i)),
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t' ht'
    by_cases hit : i ∈ t'
    · have hu : t'.erase i ⊆ s := by
        intro x hx
        have := ht' (mem_of_mem_erase hx)
        rcases mem_insert.1 this with h | h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_mem_erase hx)
        · exact h
      obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, hu𝒜⟩ := hcov _ hu
      by_cases hut : t'.erase i = t 𝒜
      · refine ⟨_, mem_union_left _ (mem_image_of_mem _ h𝒜), ?_⟩
        rw [mem_insert]; left; rw [← hut, insert_erase hit]
      · refine ⟨_, mem_union_right _ (mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_filter.2 ⟨h𝒜, ?_⟩)), ?_⟩
        · have : ({t'.erase i, t 𝒜} : Finset (Finset ι)) ⊆ 𝒜 := by
            intro x hx; simp at hx; rcases hx with rfl | rfl
            · exact hu𝒜
            · exact (ht 𝒜 h𝒜).1
          have := card_le_card this
          rw [card_pair hut] at this; exact this
        · rw [mem_image]
          exact ⟨t'.erase i, mem_erase.2 ⟨hut, hu𝒜⟩, insert_erase hit⟩
    · have hu : t' ⊆ s := by
        intro x hx
        rcases mem_insert.1 (ht' hx) with h | h
        · exact absurd (h ▸ hx) hit
        · exact h
      obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, hu𝒜⟩ := hcov _ hu
      exact ⟨_, mem_union_left _ (mem_image_of_mem _ h𝒜), mem_insert_of_mem hu𝒜⟩
  · intro B hB
    rcases mem_union.1 hB with hB | hB
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      exact ⟨_, mem_insert_self _ _⟩
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      obtain ⟨h𝒜, h2⟩ := mem_filter.1 h𝒜
      have : 0 < #((𝒜.erase (t 𝒜)).image (insert i)) := by
        rw [hc2 𝒜 h𝒜]; omega
      exact card_pos.1 this
  · intro B hB u hu
    have hs' : ∀ 𝒜 ∈ P, ∀ u ∈ 𝒜, u ⊆ insert i s := fun 𝒜 h u hu =>
      (hsub 𝒜 h u hu).trans (subset_insert _ _)
    rcases mem_union.1 hB with hB | hB
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      rcases mem_insert.1 hu with rfl | hu
      · exact insert_subset_insert _ (hsub 𝒜 h𝒜 _ (ht 𝒜 h𝒜).1)
      · exact hs' 𝒜 h𝒜 u hu
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      obtain ⟨h𝒜, _⟩ := mem_filter.1 h𝒜
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hu
      exact insert_subset_insert _ (hsub 𝒜 h𝒜 _ (mem_of_mem_erase hv))
  · intro B hB
    rcases mem_union.1 hB with hB | hB
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      have hx : ∀ u ∈ 𝒜, r ≤ dist (∑ k ∈ insert i (t 𝒜), f k) (∑ k ∈ u, f k) := by
        intro u hu
        have hti : i ∉ t 𝒜 := hiu 𝒜 h𝒜 _ (ht 𝒜 h𝒜).1
        have h1 := (ht 𝒜 h𝒜).2 u hu
        have h2 := hgd (∑ k ∈ insert i (t 𝒜), f k) (∑ k ∈ u, f k)
        have h3 : g (∑ k ∈ insert i (t 𝒜), f k) = g (f i) + g (∑ k ∈ t 𝒜, f k) := by
          rw [sum_insert hti, map_add]
        linarith
      intro u hu v hv huv
      simp only [coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, mem_coe] at hu hv
      rcases hu with rfl | hu <;> rcases hv with rfl | hv
      · exact absurd rfl huv
      · exact hx v hv
      · rw [dist_comm]; exact hx u hu
      · exact hsep 𝒜 h𝒜 hu hv huv
    · obtain ⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hB
      obtain ⟨h𝒜, _⟩ := mem_filter.1 h𝒜
      intro u hu v hv huv
      simp only [mem_coe] at hu hv
      obtain ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hu
      obtain ⟨v', hv', rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hv
      have hne' : u' ≠ v' := fun h => huv (by rw [h])
      rw [sum_insert (hiu 𝒜 h𝒜 _ (mem_of_mem_erase hu')),
        sum_insert (hiu 𝒜 h𝒜 _ (mem_of_mem_erase hv')), dist_add_left]
      exact hsep 𝒜 h𝒜 (mem_of_mem_erase hu') (mem_of_mem_erase hv') hne'
  · intro j
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, filter_union]
    refine (card_union_le _ _).trans ?_
    have h1 : #((P.image (fun 𝒜 => insert (insert i (t 𝒜)) 𝒜)).filter fun 𝒜 => j < #𝒜) ≤
        #(P.filter fun 𝒜 => j - 1 < #𝒜) := by
      calc _ ≤ #((P.filter fun 𝒜 => j - 1 < #𝒜).image
            (fun 𝒜 => insert (insert i (t 𝒜)) 𝒜)) := by
            apply card_le_card
            intro x hx
            simp only [mem_filter, mem_image] at hx ⊢
            obtain ⟨⟨𝒜, h𝒜, rfl⟩, hj⟩ := hx
            refine ⟨𝒜, ⟨h𝒜, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
            rw [hc1 𝒜 h𝒜] at hj
            have := card_pos.2 (hne 𝒜 h𝒜)
            omega
        _ ≤ _ := card_image_le
    have h2 : #(((P.filter (fun 𝒜 => 2 ≤ #𝒜)).image
        (fun 𝒜 => (𝒜.erase (t 𝒜)).image (insert i))).filter fun 𝒜 => j < #𝒜) ≤
        #(P.filter fun 𝒜 => j + 1 < #𝒜) := by
      calc _ ≤ #((P.filter fun 𝒜 => j + 1 < #𝒜).image
            (fun 𝒜 => (𝒜.erase (t 𝒜)).image (insert i))) := by
            apply card_le_card
            intro x hx
            simp only [mem_filter, mem_image] at hx ⊢
            obtain ⟨⟨𝒜, ⟨h𝒜, h2⟩, rfl⟩, hj⟩ := hx
            refine ⟨𝒜, ⟨h𝒜, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
            rw [hc2 𝒜 h𝒜] at hj
            omega
        _ ≤ _ := card_image_le
    rcases j with _ | j
    · have := Nat.add_le_add (h1.trans (hprof 0)) (h2.trans (hprof 1))
      rw [loBnd_succ_zero]; simpa using this
    · have := Nat.add_le_add (h1.trans (hprof j)) (h2.trans (hprof (j + 2)))
      rw [loBnd_succ_succ]; simpa using this
